artworks.title: Un Vieux Quartier de Vitré (Ille-et-Vilaine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a narrow street in an old quarter. The scene is symmetrical, with buildings on either side of the street. The horizon is in the center, with buildings extending into the distance. The buildings have medieval or historical architecture, with detail in the line work capturing their wooden and stone textures. The image is in black and grey tones, giving it a nostalgic feel. Figures and market stalls are seen near the viewer, while the street narrows and converges in the background.

artworks.title: The Wagg-Poids, Amsterdam
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a historical cityscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The scene shows a bustling town across a river, with a series of buildings along the horizon. The etching uses fine lines and detailed work, creating an intricate, monochrome depiction. Close to the viewer, there is a cobbled street with barrels and carts leading towards the river, where moored ships with towering masts are visible. In the distance, there are elaborate building facades surrounded by leafless trees, and the sky features wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Port de Trouville
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a harbor. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with buildings and boats along it. Several sailboats are anchored along the shore, some with sails down and some partially up. The style uses fine lines to outline sky, water, and land with shading for depth. The color scheme is black on a cream background. Buildings and trees are visible in the distance. Soft cloud formations are suggested in the sky.

artworks.title: Souvenir d’Italie
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon line is in the upper third of the composition. A faint silhouette of a structure is visible against the sky. A solitary figure walks along a dirt path bordered by grass and tall, spindly trees. The trees are depicted with delicate lines suggesting movement. The ground is detailed with a mix of short and long strokes. The distant landscape shows light and shadow, enhancing the depth. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones. The etching technique with precise lines gives the artwork a detailed quality.

artworks.title: Vue d’Église et Entrée du Village d’Essômes
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a street view from a slightly elevated position of a village road lined with buildings and trees. A large church with a tower and spire stands out in the background. The artwork employs delicate linework resembling an etching, with fine lines outlining the buildings and foliage. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving a historical or vintage quality. Trees and roofs are in the foreground, framing the street, which curves towards the church. Faint clouds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Tour de Montalban, Amsterdam
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape of a bustling canal in Amsterdam. There are buildings on both sides of the canal, with a clock tower known as the Montelbaanstoren slightly off-center to the right. The composition is balanced, with detailed pen-like strokes emphasizing architectural features and foliage texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and black tones. Closest to the viewer are moored boats, people, and trees. In the distance, the canal extends under a bridge towards more boats and rooftops.

artworks.title: Rouen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a town with tall gothic buildings in the distance, framed by trees. A dirt path leads towards the city with two figures walking on it. To the right, there is a dense collection of trees. The sky has scattered clouds. The artwork features a monochromatic palette with a focus on light and dark contrast.

artworks.title: Vue du Bas Meudon, Bords de la Seine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view across a river towards the opposite bank. The horizon is in the upper portion with distant trees and buildings in the background. The artwork features detailed linework typical of etching techniques, creating a precise and structured appearance. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white. In the foreground, a river with a small boat can be seen. On the bank, figures and carriages are shown on a road leading to a building with a flag. In the distance, buildings and trees add depth to the composition. The sky is filled with clouds depicted with intricate linework.

artworks.title: Boulevard Montmartre
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a city street scene from an elevated viewpoint. The street is bustling with activity, lined with multi-story buildings. The horizon line is low, creating depth. Fine line work captures architectural details and lively movement. The monochromatic palette uses black, gray, and white. Trees, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians populate the scene. Light clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: Vue de la Ville de Delft
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Delft from a slightly elevated point, allowing for a broad depiction of the riverside cityscape. The horizon is in the middle, showing the architectural silhouette of the city with towers and spires. The brushstrokes give texture to the buildings, clouds, and water. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between dark elements like trees and shadows and light areas of sky and water. Some boats are on the river, and buildings line the waterways. In the distance, the city's skyline is visible against billowing clouds.

artworks.title: Landscape with Clump of Four Trees
artworks.artist: Maxime Lalanne, after Pierre Émile de Crisenoy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: This image shows a straight-on view of a group of tall, leafy trees dominating the central area. The horizon is positioned slightly above the lower third, where the land rises gently towards the right. The horizon is clear with more trees and small hills in the distance. The sketch features fine line work and cross-hatching, creating textures in the foliage and clouds. The color palette is black ink on cream or light brown paper, giving the scene a serene atmosphere. The foreground has small plants and rough terrain, while the middle distance shows grazing animals and more trees. Linear strokes suggest wispy clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Church Interior
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is from within a grand cathedral interior, looking down the central nave towards the distant altar. The gothic arches and columns lead to the vaulted ceilings with intricate designs. The style features precise, linear brushstrokes highlighting architectural details. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black emphasizing lines and shadows. Figures stand by the side, pews lead further in, and the altar is surrounded by ornate details.

artworks.title: Castle with Two Wings
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a view of an architectural structure with steep-roofed buildings positioned centrally. The perspective is slightly angled, capturing the main building's side and front, and adjacent structures. Trees partially frame the buildings against the sky. The artwork is created using an etching technique with fine linework, detailing trees and architectural elements. The monochromatic color palette features shades of brown and black. The sky above contains subtle cloud formations.

artworks.title: Castle with Two Towers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a historic building with detailed architecture. The scene includes the building, a sky with soft cloud formations, vegetation, paths, and a smaller structure next to the main building. The artwork uses fine line work and a muted color palette primarily consisting of beige and gray tones.

artworks.title: City Ramparts
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a scene from a ground-level point of view. The horizon is subtly placed beyond the trees on the left side of the image. In the center, a stone structure with a large arched doorway extends vertically, dominating the scene to the right. The technique uses fine and precise linework to capture the details of the architecture and surrounding trees. The path leading to the structure is lined with trees that cast thin shadows on the ground. Two figures walk along this path, one closer to us and the other further away. The overall color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of black and beige providing depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Daedalus and Icarus
artworks.artist: Georg Siegmund Facius, and Johann Gottlieb Facius, after Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: stipple etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image depicts two male figures, focusing on the upper half of their bodies. One man is seated and leaning back, mostly nude with a cloth covering his lower body. He has defined muscles and his face is partially turned away, showing only the bridge of his nose and lips. The man standing behind him holds the seated man's arm and shoulder. This standing man has a determined expression with furrowed brows and curly hair. He wears a long-sleeved robe gathered at the waist. The background shows a tree and foliage visible through a window, with ornamental drapery and a tiled floor. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Title Page for “Atlas Novus (New Atlas)”
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythical figures and elaborate decorations. The scene includes classical mythological elements, with figures dressed in ancient Roman or Greek attire like helmets and armor. At the top, a celestial scene shows a chariot pulled by horses in the sky emitting rays of light. Below, various figures are depicted, some seated and others standing, engaging with each other, some holding scrolls or maps. The presence of exotic animals like a camel and people in diverse attire suggests themes of exploration or cartography. The drawing also features lush drapery, pillars, and a mythological figure supporting a globe.

artworks.title: Flora
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort, after Frans Floris I
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a stone bench, facing slightly sideways but looking back at the viewer. The person has classical facial features, curly hair with a floral crown, and is wearing draped clothing reminiscent of ancient Greco-Roman attire. They hold a basket of flowers in one arm and a bouquet in the other hand. Flowers in a vase are on the ground nearby. The background includes clouds and mountains. The engraving is detailed in a classical style.

artworks.title: Apollo Sauroctonos
artworks.artist: Jan de Bisschop, after the Antique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a nude male figure standing in a contrapposto position, leaning his left arm on a ornately carved wooden pedestal. His right arm hangs loosely by his side and his left leg is slightly bent, supporting much of his weight on his right leg. The man's facial features include a strong jawline, a straight nose, and distinct, forward-looking eyes, with a head of curly hair that is styled in a voluminous, classical manner. He appears to be gazing slightly upwards with a calm expression. Wrapped around the pedestal is a draped fabric that adds texture and contrast to the smooth, muscular physique of the figure. The background is plain, with subtle shading to suggest a sense of depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Apollo with the Omphalos
artworks.artist: Jan de Bisschop, after the Antique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a classical male figure standing in a relaxed pose. He leans on a fluted column with his left arm and holds a laurel wreath in his right hand. The figure has a stern expression, curly hair tied in a bun, and defined musculature. He stands barefoot, with his right leg slightly bent. The column has a decorative top design, and simple hatched lines in the background provide depth.

artworks.title: Veüe générale de la Ville et du Chateau de Versailles du côté des Jardins (View of Versailles)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of the Château de Versailles and its gardens. The perspective is elevated, offering a comprehensive view from the gardens to the distant horizon. The horizon includes the Versailles Palace, bordered by trees and landscape elements under a cloudy sky. The artwork likely uses fine lines and detailing consistent with engravings or historical etchings, accentuating the symmetry of the gardens. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, gray, and beige-brown. Below are arranged flora, fountains, walkways, and structures, with sailing ships, fountains, and figures depicted closer to us. The layout narrows towards the central palace, creating depth and guiding the viewer's gaze.

artworks.title: La Chute de Phaëton (The Fall of Phaeton)
artworks.artist: comte de Anne-Claude-Philippe de Tubières Caylus and Nicolas Le Sueur, after Giuseppe Cesari
artworks.medium: etching and chiaroscuro woodcut printed in black, light blue, and gray on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image features horses and figures in motion amidst swirling clouds. The composition depicts horses rearing and tangled in a chaotic manner, with dramatic lighting suggesting a powerful light source. The figures are dynamically positioned within the scene, showing careful attention to form and musculature. The lines are fluid and controlled, with shading adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Bacchus in a Niche
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.6 × 11.5 cm (8 1/2 × 4 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular, nude male figure with curly hair holding a branch with leaves and grapes in one hand and a shallow bowl in the other. A smaller figure, surrounded by grape vines, is situated next to him. In the background, there is an arched niche with radial lines. An inscription is visible beneath the figures.

artworks.title: Pallas Athena
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure from the waist up, facing right. The figure is standing and holding a staff in their right hand. They have straight nose, full lips, wavy hair protruding from under a helmet decorated with feathers and ornate designs. The figure is wearing a draped garment and holding a shield with a carved head of Medusa on the left arm. In the background, there is an owl on a cloud, set against a sky with swirling line patterns.
